name: ROI to ROI Tracking - with dtiInit
summary: This app will perform tracking between 2 cortical regions of interest (ROIs) from either a freesurfer parcellation or an atlas parcellation.
description: This app will perform tracking between 2 cortical regions of interest (ROIs) from either a freesurfer parcellation or an atlas parcellation.  Inputs include: parcellation (freesurfer; atlas optional) with ROI niftis (generated from app-roiGeneration), dt6 from dtiinit, and ROI pairings. Outputs include a track.tck for each pairing of ROIs, a classification structure, and a fg_classified structure which can then be fed into other apps on the website (example: Clean WMC Output).
